title: Breaded Tofu with Curry Roasted Cauliflower & Apple-Raisin Salad

steps.text: Cut tofu into ½-inch thick slices along the short side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.

Wash, dry, and separate cauliflower into bite-sized florets; cut stems into smaller pieces and transfer to a large baking sheet. Drizzle with oil, then season with curry powder and salt; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing halfway through, until cauliflower is fork-tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place bread crumbs and spices in a small bowl; stir to combine.

Place tofu on the baking sheet. Spread half of the mayo over top side of the tofu, sprinkle with half of the bread crumb mixture, then drizzle with half of the oil. Carefully flip tofu and repeat with remaining mayo, bread crumbs, and oil.
Add baking sheet to the oven and bake until tofu is golden and warmed through, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, and spices in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Wash, dry, quarter, and core apples; cut into matchsticks or coarsely grate. Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with raisins, and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide tofu, cauliflower, and apple salad between plates; enjoy!
